data.name: Dock_EROFSAlgorithmHint
data.value: lz4 packs faster; lz4hc spends more time searching for a smaller image (EROFS records the same LZ4 codec either way). lzma, deflate and zstd choose a different on-disk codec. The compression level only affects the searching encoders.

data.name: Dock_EROFSCompLevelHint
data.value: Higher values search harder for a smaller image: it drives the lz4hc search depth and the fast lz4 density/speed trade-off.

data.name: Dock_EROFSFeaturesHint
data.value: Edit the on-disk feature declaration of a preserved EROFS image, using the upstream feature names: a name sets its bit, a name prefixed with "!" clears it, and "auto" keeps both superblock words derived. Left empty, the declaration recorded from the source image is inherited unchanged.
